mentions.name: Akariq
mentions.description: A travel eSIM service selling data plans for 190+ countries that works without any app or account. It emphasizes reliability with backup eSIM resources and free replacement eSIMs, staying online during industry-wide provider outages, and has served users in regions like China with smooth connectivity including tethering support.
mentions.problem: Major eSIM providers can suffer outages that leave travelers offline; Akariq keeps customers connected during such disruptions via backup resources and free replacement eSIMs.
mentions.audience: Travelers who need mobile data connectivity abroad, including individual customers reaching out for support
mentions.source_excerpt: I sell travel eSIM plans for 190+ countries, no app or account needed!
mentions.author: helloakariq

mentions.name: Akariq
mentions.description: This service sells travel eSIM data plans covering 180+ countries. It requires no app and no user account, enabling a 3-click install, provides full transparency about plan details such as unlimited plan speed caps, connects to the best local network in each country (e.g., Viettel in Vietnam instead of VTC), and is positioned as 2-3x cheaper than Airalo and other big players.
mentions.problem: Other eSIM providers hide plan details like unlimited plan speed caps and connect to inferior networks, and their plans cost 2-3x more.
mentions.audience: International travelers needing mobile data abroad
mentions.source_excerpt: I am continuing to work on Akariq [0] which provides travel eSIM data plans to 180+ countries around the world.
